# Verse Engine by Ctruh

> Verse Engine by Ctruh is a browser-native 3D engine. It turns 3D files, scans, floor plans and Blender, Unity or Unreal projects into one link that opens in a modern web browser, with no app to install. Made by Ctruh (https://www.ctruh.com/).
